role_description: Designs, develops, and maintains software applications and systems.
Builds and maintains the server-side logic, databases, and APIs of web applications.
Develops the user interface and user-facing features of websites and web applications.
Handles both frontend and backend development tasks, managing the entire application stack.
Specializes in writing backend logic, automation scripts, and APIs using the Python programming language.
Designs and develops robust, enterprise-grade backend applications using Java.
Builds high-performance applications, system software, and embedded systems using C and C++.
Creates applications for mobile devices and platforms.
Develops mobile applications specifically for the Android operating system using Kotlin or Java.
Develops mobile applications specifically for Apple's iOS ecosystem using Swift or Objective-C.
Designs and programs video games for PC, console, or mobile platforms.
Monitors organizational networks for security breaches and investigates violations.
Works within a Security Operations Center to triage security alerts and manage incidents in real-time.
common_alternative_titles: Security Operations Center Analyst; Tier 1 Security Analyst

role_description: Designs and implements security systems, firewalls, and encryption to protect organizational data.
Advises organizations on how to protect their physical capital and data securely.
Legally simulates cyberattacks to identify vulnerabilities in computer systems and networks.
Scans IT infrastructure for security weaknesses and coordinates patching.
Secures the software development lifecycle by reviewing code and identifying application vulnerabilities.
Implements and maintains security controls within cloud infrastructure environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Secures network boundaries, configures firewalls, and maintains secure VPN access.
Leads the technical response to active cyber attacks and data breaches.
Analyzes digital evidence to investigate computer crimes or policy violations.
Researches and analyzes cyber threat actors, campaigns, and tactics to preempt attacks.
Reverse-engineers malicious software to understand its behavior and develop signatures.
Designs the overarching security infrastructure and strategy for an organization.
Ensures IT security policies align with regulatory compliance and manages IT risk assessments.
Collects, cleans, and analyzes data to help organizations make business decisions.
Uses statistical methods and machine learning algorithms to extract insights from complex data.
Builds and maintains scalable data pipelines and architectures for data ingestion and processing.
Designs and deploys machine learning models into production systems.
Develops intelligent algorithms and applications utilizing deep learning and neural networks.
Specializes in developing algorithms that enable computers to understand and process human language.
Builds models that allow computers to process, analyze, and understand visual data from the world.
Focuses on the deployment, monitoring, and operationalization of machine learning models.
Conducts foundational research to advance the state-of-the-art in artificial intelligence algorithms.
Designs, builds, and maintains cloud infrastructure environments and services.
Oversees a company's cloud computing strategy, including cloud adoption and application design.
Bridges the gap between software development and IT operations to enable continuous integration and deployment.
Applies software engineering principles to operations to ensure highly reliable and scalable software systems.
Builds internal developer platforms to increase developer velocity and standardize deployments.
Designs and builds the underlying servers, networks, and systems (often via code) that run applications.
Designs, implements, and maintains local and wide-area networks.
Manages day-to-day operations of organizational networks and hardware.
Installs, configures, and supports an organization's local area networks and internet systems.
Provides help and advice to people and organizations using computer software or equipment.
Oversees the engineering, business, and management aspects of complex IT projects and systems.
Uses specialized software to store and organize data securely, ensuring database performance.
Designs and develops large-scale database solutions and data storage systems.
Writes SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers for database operations and reporting.
Designs the blueprints for an organization's data management frameworks and schemas.
Creates websites, ensuring they are visually appealing, functional, and user-friendly.
Builds complex web-based software applications (SaaS) rather than static websites.
